description: Curated smoke-test camera set with deterministic baseline traffic states for model verification (Sprint 4 T7 / ADR-005 Finding B).

cameras.camera_name: Mai Chí Thọ - Nguyễn Cơ Thạch 1
cameras.title: TTH 5.1
cameras.rationale: Wide 12-lane boulevard across the Thủ Thiêm urban axis. Off-peak volume is low with wide continuous lanes, clear line-of-sight, and minimal cross-traffic friction. Consistently produces low PCU count (SI < 0.35).

cameras.title: TTH 59.1
cameras.rationale: Wide arterial roadway section with open multi-lane profile and low roadside commercial density. Off-peak traffic runs smoothly with negligible queuing (SI < 0.35).

cameras.title: TTH 20.1
cameras.rationale: High-capacity grade-separated highway junction at the southwest edge of the city. Outside peak holiday or rush hours, traffic disperses freely across wide grade-separated ramps (SI < 0.35).

cameras.title: TTH 6.1
cameras.rationale: Wide canal-side boulevard directly approaching the Saigon River Tunnel entrance. Unobstructed flow and high travel speed during off-peak windows with zero intersection stacking (SI < 0.35).

cameras.title: ITS 3.4
cameras.rationale: Multi-lane one-way arterial stretch in District 3. Off-peak coordinated green signals allow free-flowing vehicle platoons with low localized congestion (SI < 0.35).

cameras.camera_name: Cộng Hòa - Tân Kỳ Tân Quý
cameras.title: ITS 6.2
cameras.rationale: Severe chronic bottleneck intersection connecting Northwest suburban districts (Tân Phú, Bình Tân) towards the airport and city center. Over-saturated signal cycles cause multi-hundred-meter tailbacks (SI >= 0.90).

cameras.title: TTH 38.1
cameras.rationale: Critical convergence node of two major commuter arteries (Trường Chinh and Cộng Hòa). High volumes of buses and motorcycles merging from An Sương create persistent peak-hour gridlock (SI >= 0.90).

cameras.camera_name: Điện Biên Phủ - Nguyễn Gia Trí
cameras.title: TTH 419
cameras.rationale: Gateway chokepoint between Hàng Xanh intersection and Saigon Bridge. Dense university traffic and side-street merging cause dense queue spillbacks during evening rush hours (SI >= 0.90).

cameras.camera_name: Điện Biên Phủ - Cách Mạng Tháng Tám
cameras.title: ITS 1.1
cameras.rationale: Dense urban cross-intersection linking District 3 and District 10. Long signal cycles and high cross-traffic volume lead to chronic peak-hour queue accumulation (SI >= 0.90).

cameras.camera_name: Mai Chí Thọ - Đồng Văn Cống 2
cameras.title: TTH 3.2
cameras.rationale: Primary heavy freight junction leading to Cát Lái container port. During afternoon/evening container gate-in hours, multi-lane truck and container queues form dense, persistent congestion (SI >= 0.90).
